headlines.title: 中澳（大利亚）两国央行续签双边本币互换协议

headlines.title_en: Chinese and Australian central banks renew bilateral local currency swap agreement
headlines.summary_en: With State Council approval, the People's Bank of China recently renewed the bilateral local currency swap agreement with the Reserve Bank of Australia, expanding the scale from 200 billion yuan/41 billion Australian dollars to 220 billion yuan/46 billion Australian dollars, with a five-year validity period extendable by mutual consent. The renewal and expansion of the swap agreement will help deepen bilateral monetary and financial cooperation, facilitate trade and investment, and maintain financial market stability. (PBOC website)

headlines.title: 据悉俄罗斯8月将从亚洲接收近27万吨成品油
headlines.summary: 据初步航运数据和贸易消息人士，俄罗斯8月将通过船对船转运从亚洲进口近27万吨成品油，以缓解乌克兰袭击其炼油厂造成的燃料短缺。俄罗斯通常是燃料净出口国，但在过去数月乌克兰持续袭击其能源设施导致炼油产量下降、全国范围出现燃料短缺后，被迫转向进口。根据数据和消息人士透露，俄罗斯8月从亚洲进口的近27万吨成品油中约三分之一来自印度，其余在韩国和马来西亚等国沿海装载。这些由贸易商安排的货物在油轮之间转移，很可能是为了掩盖来源和航线，因与俄罗斯的贸易可能引发西方制裁。数据显示7月没有此类货物运抵俄罗斯。根据船舶追踪机构Vortexa和Kpler的数据以及贸易消息人士

headlines.title_en: Russia to receive nearly 270,000 tons of refined oil from Asia in August, sources say
headlines.summary_en: According to preliminary shipping data and trade sources, Russia will import nearly 270,000 metric tons of refined oil products from Asia via ship-to-ship transfers in August to ease fuel shortages caused by Ukrainian strikes on its refineries. Russia, typically a net fuel exporter, has turned to imports after months of Ukrainian attacks on its energy facilities reduced refining output and triggered nationwide shortages. About one-third of the August imports from Asia come from India, with the rest loaded off South Korea and Malaysia, according to data and sources. The cargoes, arranged by traders, are transferred between tankers, likely to conceal origin and route as trade with Russia could trigger Western sanctions. Data shows no such shipments arrived in July, based on vessel tracking from Vortexa and Kpler and trade sources.

headlines.title_en: Times New Material: Net profit of 346 million yuan in H1 2026, up 14.08% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Times New Material announced H1 2026 revenue of 10.467 billion yuan, up 13.09% year-on-year; net profit attributable to shareholders was 346 million yuan, up 14.08%; non-GAAP net profit was 312 million yuan, up 33.91%. Prior-year net profit was 303 million yuan. The company plans a cash dividend of 0.90 yuan per 10 shares (tax included).

headlines.title_en: US stock movement: New Oriental extends pre-market gains by 2.5%, following three consecutive days of gains, with strong earnings and heavy bullish institutional sentiment
headlines.summary_en: New Oriental's Hong Kong shares rose over 4% today, lifting its US-listed shares (EDU.US) 2.5% premarket, following three consecutive days of gains. The company's FY2026 Q4 results were strong, with quarterly revenue of $1.529 billion, up 23% year-on-year and beating expectations, while net profit surged 775.8%. Full-year revenue reached $5.661 billion, up 15.5%. Several brokerages reaffirmed or raised ratings and target prices post-results, including Orient Securities maintaining a 'Buy' on resilient growth in new education businesses and test prep, Daiwa noting overseas restructuring supports margin expansion, and Shenwan Hongyuan sharply raising revenue and profit forecasts with a 'Buy' reiteration.

headlines.title: 监管出手 部分私募自查特定基金净值
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月19日讯，近期，多地证监局都陆续向辖区内私募管理人发送了自查通知，信息披露真实性、风险控制等成为自查关键内容。与此同时，近日有业内人士透露，中国证券投资基金业协会向部分私募证券投资基金管理人下发专项通知，要求对特定基金净值表现开展自查。业内人士表示，8月1日《私募证券投资基金运作指引》过渡期届满，私募管理人需根据运作指引进一步提升合规意识，优化合规体系，方能实现长期发展。

headlines.title_en: Regulators act; some private funds conduct self-inspection of specific fund net values
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data August 19 - Recently, multiple local CSRC bureaus have issued self-inspection notices to private fund managers in their regions, with information disclosure accuracy and risk control as key focus areas. Separately, industry sources said the Asset Management Association of China has sent special notices to some private securities fund managers requiring self-inspections of specific fund net value performance. With the transition period for the Private Securities Investment Fund Operating Guidelines ending on August 1, managers need to enhance compliance awareness and systems for long-term development.

headlines.title: 微博：二季度总营收4.538亿美元，调整后运营利润1.254亿美元
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月19日讯，微博(09898.HK)发布2026年第二季度财报，微博二季度总营收4.538亿美元（约合人民币30.8亿元），其中广告营收3.81亿美元（约合人民币25.84亿元），二季度调整后运营利润1.254亿美元（约合人民币8.46亿元），调整后运营利润率达到28%。用户方面，截至二季度末，微博的月活跃用户达到5.61亿，日活跃用户达到2.54亿。

headlines.title_en: Weibo: Q2 total revenue of $453.8 million, adjusted operating profit of $125.4 million
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data August 19 - Weibo (09898.HK) reported Q2 2026 revenue of $453.8 million (approx. 3.08 billion yuan), with advertising revenue of $381 million (approx. 2.584 billion yuan). Adjusted operating profit was $125.4 million (approx. 846 million yuan), with an adjusted operating margin of 28%. As of quarter-end, monthly active users reached 561 million and daily active users 254 million.
